defects.quote: WHEN an admin removes a member, the system SHALL keep each booking of theirs that starts within
defects.description: Keep near-term bookings keeps the removed member's bookings that start within 48 hours, while Cancel upcoming bookings cancels every booking of theirs that has not started yet; a booking 32 hours away cannot be both kept and cancelled.

defects.quote: - THEN she is told to make another member an admin first, and she stays a member
defects.description: The Removing yourself scenario refuses removal of the club's only admin, but no rule states that refusal (the Remove a member rule says any member an admin removes loses access); it should be a rule or an open question.
The Problem names the solution's screen (removing the member from "the members page") instead of describing only Priya's situation.
